disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate of registration.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud or deceit in obtaining a certificate of registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of soil classifying.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any gross negligence, incompetence, or misconduct in the practice of soil classifying.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of an offense with a direct bearing on ability to serve the public, or failure to be sufficiently rehabilitated.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any offense determined by the board to have a direct bearing upon a registrant's ability to serve the public as a professional soil classifier, or the board determines, following conviction of any offense, that a registrant is not sufficiently rehabilitated under section 12.1-33-02.1.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the code of ethics adopted and promulgated by the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the code of ethics adopted and promulgated by the board.

definition_quote.value: Practice of soil classifying and practice of professional soil classifying means any service or work the adequate performance of which requires education in the physical, chemical, biological, and soil sciences, training and experience in the application of the special knowledge of these sciences to soil classification, the soil classification by accepted principles and methods, investigation, evaluation, and consultation on the effect of measured, observed, and inferred soil properties upon the various uses, the preparation of soil descriptions, maps and reports and interpretive drawings, maps and reports of soil properties and the effect of soil properties upon the various uses, and the effect of the various uses upon kinds of soil
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of soil classifying and practice of professional soil classifying" means any service or work the adequate performance of which requires education in the physical, chemical, biological, and soil sciences, training and experience in the application of the special knowledge of these sciences to soil classification, the soil classification by accepted principles and methods, investigation, evaluation, and consultation on the effect of measured, observed, and inferred soil properties upon the various uses, the preparation of soil descriptions, maps and reports and interpretive drawings, maps and reports of soil properties and the effect of soil properties upon the various uses, and the effect of the various uses upon kinds of soil

teaching_or_research_counts_as_experienc.quote: Is a person with experience of not less than four years of soil classification research or as a teacher of soils in a college or university offering an approved soils curriculum of four years or more, and a minimum of two years of soil classifying experience

responsible_charge_definition_included.quote: "Responsible charge" means direct control and personal supervision of soil classification.

nonresident_temporary_permit_available.quote: may be granted a temporary permit for a definite period of time not to exceed one year to do a specific job

private_employer_exemption.quote: The practice of soil classifying by any person regularly employed to perform soil classifying services solely for that person's employer or for a subsidiary or affiliated corporation or limited liability company of that person's employer, providing the soil classifying performed is in connection with the property, products, or services of that person's employer.

soil_fertility_sampling_excluded_from_sc.quote: does not mean or include ... the work ordinarily performed by persons who sample and test soil for fertility status

code_of_ethics_required.quote: to adopt and promulgate a code of ethics which is binding upon all persons registered under or subject to this chapter.

minimum_exam_passing_score.quote: The passing grade on any examination may not be less than seventy percent.

reexamination_minimum_score_waiting_peri.quote: Any candidate for registration having an average grade of less than fifty percent may not apply for re-examination for a period of one year from the date of such examination.

board_includes_public_member.quote: The board consists of three professional soil classifiers appointed by the governor and two members at large appointed by the governor.
